record.paper_title: Open Questions in High Energy Spin Physics
record.original_question: Determine the size and significance of spin-dependent quark-gluon correlations in the nucleon, especially whether dynamical higher-twist contributions are always small. The open question is whether low-Q² lepton-scattering data can be connected to the deep-inelastic scattering regime by including only kinematic higher-twist effects, as in a generalized Wandzura-Wilczek approximation, thereby giving a theoretical foundation for parton-hadron duality speculations.

evidence.quote: What are the spin-dependent quark-gluon correlations in the nucleon?
The matrix elements of quark-gluon correlations can be extracted from these data. They appear very small. Perhaps dynamical higher twist is always small.
The generalized Wandzura-Wilczek approximation offers the promise of a solid theoretical foundations for speculations about “parton-hadron duality” in low energy lepton scattering.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the spin-dependent structure of the nucleon as probed by polarized lepton-nucleon scattering. The polarized structure function g_2(x,Q^2) admits a decomposition

  g_2(x,Q^2) = g_2^{WW}(x,Q^2) + \bar g_2(x,Q^2),

where the Wandzura–Wilczek part is

  g_2^{WW}(x,Q^2) = -g_1(x,Q^2) + \int_x^1 \frac{dy}{y}\, g_1(y,Q^2),

and \bar g_2 encodes genuine twist-three quark-gluon correlations, expressible through nucleon matrix elements of bilocal operators of the form \bar\psi(0)\, G^{+\mu}(z)\,\psi(0) (e.g.\ the matrix elements parameterised by the twist-3 distribution that defines the d_2 moment d_2(Q^2) = \int_0^1 dx\, x^2 [2 g_1(x,Q^2) + 3 g_2(x,Q^2)]). A "generalized Wandzura–Wilczek approximation" extends the leading-twist Wandzura–Wilczek relation by retaining all kinematic higher-twist (target-mass and finite-Q^2) corrections while neglecting dynamical higher-twist quark-gluon correlations.

Problem.

(a) Determine the size and statistical significance of the spin-dependent quark-gluon correlation matrix elements in the nucleon (in particular d_2 and the analogous twist-3 matrix elements appearing in \bar g_2 and in the transverse-spin sector), and decide whether dynamical higher-twist contributions to polarized inclusive lepton-nucleon scattering are uniformly small across the relevant kinematics.

(b) Establish whether low-Q^2 polarized lepton-nucleon scattering data can be quantitatively connected to the deep-inelastic regime by including only kinematic higher-twist effects—i.e.\ whether the generalized Wandzura–Wilczek approximation reproduces the observed structure functions (after accounting for elastic and resonance contributions) within experimental uncertainties.

(c) If (b) holds, derive from first principles in QCD a theoretical justification, based on the smallness of dynamical twist-3 matrix elements, for the empirical phenomenon of parton-hadron (Bloom–Gilman) duality in polarized lepton scattering at low Q^2.
artifact.category_tag: Polarized nucleon structure functions and higher-twist QCD
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (2018–2024) continue to develop generalized Wandzura–Wilczek relations and to extract twist-3 quark-gluon correlations (such as d_2 and related matrix elements) from polarized DIS and lattice QCD; while measured d_2 values are small, no first-principles QCD proof that dynamical higher twist is uniformly small or that the generalized WW approximation provides a rigorous foundation for parton-hadron duality has been established. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Generalized Wandzura Wilczek Relations and Orbital Angular Momentum
status_evidence.snippet: New series of Wandzura–Wilczek relations in the off-forward sector implementing Lorentz invariance and QCD equations of motion.
status_evidence.claim: Generalized WW relations are still being developed, indicating the foundational program is ongoing.

status_evidence.title: Twist analysis of the spin-orbit correlation in QCD (2024)
status_evidence.snippet: Derives non-perturbative identities decomposing twist-3 PDFs into WW and genuine twist-3 parts.
status_evidence.claim: Recent 2024 work continues to study the genuine twist-3 quark-gluon correlations, indicating the question of their size and significance is still active.

status_evidence.title: Higher twist nucleon distribution amplitudes in WW approximation
status_evidence.snippet: Studies higher-twist nucleon distribution amplitudes in the WW approximation.
status_evidence.claim: Use of WW approximations for higher-twist objects remains a working tool, not a proven exact statement.
